## Frequently asked questions

### Where is D3 Interiors?
56, Perianna Maistry Street, near Greatway Supermarket, Periyamet, Chennai 600 003.

### What facilities does D3 Interiors have?
Modular kitchens, Bedrooms & wardrobes, Living rooms, False ceilings, Bathrooms, Pooja rooms, Offices & co-working, Retail stores & showrooms, Restaurants, clinics & salons, Factory offices & warehouses.

### How long does a project take?
After the design and quote, execution by the in-house team takes 4 to 8 weeks.

### Do you work outside Chennai?
Yes. Besides the Periyamet head office, D3 Interiors has two offices in Vellore.

### How do I book a consultation with D3 Interiors?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 72002 21617. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm.
